name: power_extra
publisher: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 / CERES), daily point API, community AG
variables: RH2M (humidity), GWETROOT (root-zone soil wetness), ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN (solar radiation)
publication_delay: Near-real-time values appear after about 2-4 days. Used at t-4 calendar days (plan minimum).
revision_policy: Near-real-time values are replaced later by the final reanalysis. The file holds final values. Same limit as the temperature and rain data of the project.
